# Data availability statement

The code of the simulations, the rates aggregated by condition, the outputs of the formal models and the scripts that reproduce every table and figure are available at https://github.com/diogoprov/pcps-sim and archived at Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23500104, all versions; v0.1.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23500105). For peer review, an anonymized copy is available at [CITAR: URL of the anonymous Zenodo deposit]. The tadpole metacommunity data of Box 1 come from published studies (Both et al., 2011; Prado & Rossa-Feres, 2014; Provete et al., 2014) and from unpublished data shared with the author, which cannot be redistributed; the repository holds only the tree shapes of the regional pools derived from them and the results of the case study.

# Use of artificial intelligence

The code and the drafts of the Methods and Results were written with the assistance of an AI model (Claude, Anthropic) under the direction of the author, who made every design decision and checked every result; the interactions are logged in docs/AI_INTERACTION_LOG.md of the code repository.
